newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt police arrest university demonstrators.
newsitem.headline: Egypt police arrest university demonstrators.

text.p: Egyptian police arrested 29 people alleged to have organised a demonstration at Zagazig University north of Cairo in which three policemen were hurt by stone-throwers, security sources said on Tuesday.
They said about 300 employees of the university demonstrated on campus on Monday to protest that they had not been paid their annual bonuses. Demonstrations are illegal in Egypt.
Police used teargas to prevent the demonstrators from leaving university grounds, the sources said. The policemen were hurt when demonstrators threw stones at the security forces.
The detainees could face charges of organising an illegal gathering, attacking the police and wasting public money, the sources said. Several windows were broken on campus by the stone-throwers
Police have issued arrest warrants for a further four university employees suspected of organising the protest, the sources said.
